## What lives here
Graph RAG: document ingestion into Mistral libraries, entity and relation extraction, the Neo4j graph store, retrieval, the query optimiser, timelines and the unified graph.

## Conventions
Neo4j is optional; the backend degrades gracefully without it.

## Entry points
`routes/rag.py`, `retrieval.py` and `graph_store.py`.
